name: Motor
role: Drives the pump shaft through the coupling halves; CR units ship with heavy-duty 2-pole motors.

name: Motor stool
role: Standoff between pump head and motor; encloses the coupling and gives access to the shaft seal.

name: Coupling guard
role: Covers the rotating coupling halves for safety.

name: Coupling guard screw
role: Fastens the coupling guards (T20, 2 Nm).

name: Coupling hex bolt
role: Clamps the coupling halves together; torque depends on bolt size (13-62 Nm).

name: Shaft pin
role: Locates the coupling half and impeller stack on the shaft.

name: Coupling half
role: Transmits motor torque to the pump shaft; halves are a matched set, never interchanged between pumps.
service_ref: CR-H service, Dismantling p. 2; coupling height pp. 18-19

name: Pump shaft
role: Carries the impellers and transmits coupling torque through the stage stack; must rotate freely by hand.
service_ref: CR-H service, Reassembly p. 11; I&O §19 problems 1h, 4f

failure_modes: single-use: must be replaced, never reused
name: Shaft lock nut
role: Retains the impeller stack on the threaded shaft end (22 Nm).
service_ref: CR-H service, Torque table p. 1; Reassembly p. 12

failure_modes: single-use: must be replaced, never reused
name: Lock washer set
role: Washer set locking the shaft nut; halves must stay paired as supplied.

failure_modes: gouging or wear at top or bottom
name: Splined (clamp) spacer
role: Spacer clamping and positioning the stack on the shaft spline.
service_ref: CR-H service, Dismantling p. 7; Reassembly p. 11

name: Stage spacer
role: Axial spacer setting stage positions within the chamber stack.

failure_source: I&O §13-14 Maintaining: check for leaks particularly at the shaft seal
name: Cartridge shaft seal
role: Cartridge seal stopping pumped fluid leaking along the shaft; cannot be disassembled, replaced as a unit.
service_ref: CR-H service, Dismantling p. 3; replacement criteria p. 10

name: Inboard seal
role: Inboard seal element used in tandem and back-to-back seal variants.

name: Shaft seal securing screw
role: 2.5 mm screws locking the seal collar to the shaft (2.5 Nm).
service_ref: CR-H service, Dismantling p. 3; Torque table p. 1

name: Pump head
role: Top pressure casing (N models) carrying the head cover, seal, and discharge outlet.

name: Pump head cover
role: Cover closing the pump head; carries the shaft seal, stack compression springs, and Cool-Top disk plate.

name: Cool-Top disk plate
role: Cool-Top plate in the head cover carrying the guide bushing.

failure_source: CR-H service p. 4 + p. 10 replacement criteria
name: Disk plate bushing
role: Bushing guiding the shaft in the disk plate.

name: Bushing retaining washer
role: Washer retaining the bushings in the disk plate.

name: Disk plate O-ring
role: O-ring sealing the disk plate; replaced whenever the pump is disassembled.
service_ref: CR-H service, Reassembly p. 13; replacement criteria p. 10

name: Head cover plug
role: Plug closing the seal-securing-screw access in the head cover.

failure_modes: single-use: must be replaced, never reused
name: PTFE stack compression spring
role: PTFE springs pressing the chamber stack together from the head cover.

name: Outer sleeve
role: Outer pressure casing enclosing the chamber stack between base and head.
service_ref: CR-H service, Dismantling p. 8; Reassembly p. 12

name: Sleeve flange
role: Flange clamping the sleeve to the pump head with screws, washers, and nuts.

name: Sleeve flange allen screw
role: Allen screws fastening the sleeve flange (75 Nm).

name: Sleeve flange washer
role: Washers under the sleeve flange screws.

name: Sleeve flange nut
role: Nuts for the sleeve flange screws.

name: Sleeve O-ring
role: O-rings sealing the sleeve joints at head and flange; the hot-section ring always seats toward the stack.

name: Suction/discharge base
role: Bottom casing with suction inlet and discharge outlet; the cartridge assembly seats into it.

name: Mounting base
role: Bedplate the pump and motor mount on; the motor slides back on rails for seal and coupling service.

name: Motor slide rail screw
role: Rail screws connecting the motor to the base; loosened to slide the motor back.
service_ref: CR-H service, Dismantling p. 2; Reassembly p. 17

name: Motor bolt
role: Bolts fastening the motor to the stool, tightened diagonally (13-23 Nm by size).
service_ref: CR-H service, Torque table p. 1; Reassembly p. 17

name: Base O-ring
role: O-ring sealing the cartridge into the base groove.

name: Cartridge support foot
role: Support plate/foot slid over the staybolts under the cartridge.

name: Staybolt
role: Long through-bolts clamping base, sleeve, and head into one pressure casing.

name: Staybolt nut
role: 24 mm nuts tensioning the staybolts (CR-H 80 Nm, CRN-H 100 Nm).
service_ref: CR-H service, Torque table p. 1; Dismantling p. 3

name: Staybolt washer
role: Washers under the staybolt nuts.

name: Cartridge assembly
role: Removable cartridge: stack, shaft, and seal handled as one service unit lifted from the base.

name: Impeller (stage) stack
role: Rotating assembly of shaft, impellers, and chambers; each stage adds head toward the rated total.
service_ref: CR-H service, Dismantling p. 7; stage assembly pp. 20-24

name: Top chamber
role: Top chamber of the stack; anchors the stack straps.

failure_modes: visible or felt groove in bore
name: Stage chamber
role: Stationary diffuser chamber of one stage, converting impeller velocity into pressure.
service_ref: CR-H service, Dismantling p. 7; stage assembly pp. 20-24

failure_modes: bearing bore over limit (SiC 23.52 mm; bronze/Graflon 22.02 mm)
name: Chamber with bearing
role: Stage chamber with an integral bearing supporting the shaft mid-stack.

name: Suction inlet connector
role: Two-piece connector feeding suction flow into the first stage.
service_ref: CR-H service, Dismantling p. 7; Reassembly p. 12

name: Neck (seal) ring
role: Wear ring sealing the impeller eyelet against the chamber; inner edge faces the impeller.

name: Seal ring retainer
role: Retainer holding the neck ring in the chamber; has a relief slot for removal.

failure_modes: outside diameter under limit (SiC 23.4 mm; TC 21.874 mm)
name: Bearing ring
role: Rotating ring running inside the chamber bearing.
service_ref: CR-H service, Dismantling p. 8; Reassembly p. 11

failure_modes: clogged impeller or guide vane passage
worn eyelet or neck-ring contact surface
name: Stage impeller
role: Rotating stage impeller adding head to the fluid; all stages sum to rated head.
service_ref: CR-H service, Dismantling p. 7; stage assembly pp. 20-24

name: Impeller wear ring
role: Replaceable wear ring pressed onto the impeller (15/20 models); the wearing surface instead of the impeller.

name: Chamber stack strap
role: Straps binding the chamber stack for handling and assembly.

name: Chamber stack strap bolt
role: Bolt tensioning the stack strap (13 mm, 15 Nm).

name: Chamber stack strap washer
role: Washer under the stack strap bolt.

name: Discharge flange
role: Flange at the discharge outlet with a greased seal groove.

name: Flange pipe plug
role: 1/4 in. pipe plug in the discharge flange.

name: Flange allen screw
role: Allen screws seating the discharge flange diagonally (20 Nm) with no gaps.

name: Flange ring
role: Flange ring on the discharge adaptor, locked by the retaining ring.

name: Flange retaining ring
role: Ring locking the flange ring into its groove.

name: Discharge O-ring
role: O-ring sealing the discharge joint.
